description: Angular component for displaying recipe details, including fetching recipe data via a service based on route parameters, and offering navigation and interaction logic.

classes.name: RecipeDetailComponent
classes.description: Component displaying detailed information about a recipe, handling data fetching, navigation, and ingredient toggling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, retrieves recipe ID from route parameters, fetches recipe data, and manages notFound state.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the main or previous page.

methods.name: toggleIngredient
methods.description: Toggles the 'checked' state of an ingredient.
